question.worked_solution:
First, we distribute the $(-4)$ over each of the terms in parentheses.

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}(-4)(8x+7y)+30y & = \\ (-4)\cdot 8x+(-4)\cdot 7y+30y & = \\ (-32x)+(-28y)+30y & = \\ -32x-28y+30y\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we collect like terms.

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}-32x-28y+30y & = \\ -32x+(-28y+30y) & = \\ -32x+2y\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
